description: This Java class defines the entity 'LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalance' for the Fineract project. It models the balance of income that has been capitalized for a specific loan, including amount, date, and related transaction details. The class is annotated with JPA annotations for ORM mapping and extends an auditable base class.

classes.name: LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalance
classes.description: Entity representing the balance of capitalized income for a loan, including fields for amount, date, unrecognized amounts, and status flags, with ORM mappings and audit capabilities.
